crossRefs.note: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
The same was in the beginning with God.
He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

translations.web: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
translations.bsb: The LORD created me as His first course, before His works of old.
translations.kjv: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works
translations.asv: Jehovah possessed me in the beginning of his way, Before his works of old.
